instruction: I need to recover the poster_party_night.webp file from the Trash. After recovery, please ensure it is no longer in the Trash.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires recovering file from Trash and verifying it's no longer in trash. Evaluator checks both file existence on Desktop AND absence from trash. Custom getter checks file status and trash status, custom metric validates both conditions.
metadata.verification: Verified that evaluator checks dual conditions: (1) file exists at Desktop location, (2) file is NOT in trash directory. Both conditions must be true for full score.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies BOTH requirements - file exists at Desktop location AND file is not in trash
Getter logic correctness: Uses appropriate bash commands (file existence check + 'gio trash --list') to extract both file status and trash status
Metric logic correctness: Properly validates both conditions with 50% weight each, correctly interprets 'not_in_trash=true' to mean file should NOT be in trash
Data flow correctness: Getter extracts the right state (file location + trash status), metric compares the right aspects (existence + trash absence)
Expected values are semantically correct: file_exists=true and not_in_trash=true accurately represent the desired end state after recovery
No postconfig needed: File state is persistent, verification can occur immediately after task execution
Robust edge case handling: Properly handles file not found and trash check with appropriate string parsing
